Selected work

Featured Projects

End-to-end analytics work: from a blank page to a database to a finished dashboard.

Project 01 · Completed

SkyLink Airlines Performance Analytics

An end-to-end project built around one question a COO would ask: how is the airline actually performing, and where are we losing money or reputation? I designed the data model, built a 12-table PostgreSQL database, analysed it with SQL, and delivered a 6-page Power BI report.

  1. Data modeling
    Entities, keys and relationships designed in DbSchema, with an ER diagram.
  2. Database creation
    12 normalized PostgreSQL tables with primary/foreign keys, CHECK constraints and indexes.
  3. SQL analysis
    Queries on revenue, punctuality, routes, passengers, crew and baggage.
  4. Power BI reporting
    Star schema with a Date table, DAX measures and 6 dashboard pages.

Project 02 · Completed

OmniCart E-commerce & Warehouse Logistics Analytics

A COO-style question: between a customer clicking Buy and the parcel reaching their door, where are we losing money, time or customers? I loaded 13 CSV files (about 230,000 rows) into Power BI, cleaned them in Power Query, modeled a star schema, wrote 97 DAX measures and built a 9-page report. All data is synthetic.

  1. Business questions
    Defined e-commerce and warehouse questions on sales, returns, delivery, inventory and suppliers.
  2. Load & clean
    13 CSV files (6 fact, 7 dimension tables) cleaned in Power Query.
  3. Star schema modeling
    Six fact tables sharing conformed dimensions, with a marked date table.
  4. DAX & dashboards
    97 measures and two dashboards: E-commerce, and Warehouse & Logistics.
